== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on March 20th, 2022.
** Was the 16th player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL.
* Reached 4000 assists in the LPL on March 2nd, 2023.
** The 10th player to reach 4000 assists in the LPL, after [[meiko]], [[Pyl (Chen Bo)|Pyl]], [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], [[xiaohu]], [[Rookie]], [[cold]], [[Doinb]], [[Crisp]], and [[LvMao]].
<!--* Reached 4500 assists in the LPL on June 18th, 2023.
** The 8th player to reach 4500 assists in the LPL, after [[meiko]], [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], [[xiaohu]], [[Rookie]], [[Crisp]], [[cold]], and [[Doinb]].-->
* Reached 5000 assists in the LPL on February 27th, 2024.
** The 6th player to reach 5000 assists in the LPL after [[meiko]], [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], [[xiaohu]], [[Crisp]], and [[Rookie]].
* Reached 6000 assists in the LPL on March 27, 2025.
** The 4th player to reach 6000 assists in the [[LPL]] after [[meiko]], [[Crisp]], and [[xiaohu]].
* Reached 300 wins in the LPL on August 05, 2023.
** Was the 18th player to reach 300 wins in the LPL.
* Reached 400 wins in the LPL on May 17, 2025.
** Was the 13th player to reach 400 wins in the LPL.
* Reached 500 games in the LPL on August 05, 2023
** The 21st player to reach 500 games in the LPL.
* Reached 600 games in the LPL on January 23, 2025
** The 14th player to reach 600 games in the LPL.

=== Individual Awards ===
* LPL 2nd All-Pro Team x3 (Summer 2022, Spring 2023, Summer 2023)
* LPL 3rd All-Pro Team x2 (Spring 2022, Spring 2024)
